capabilities: Forward emails to a personal mail2note address
Poll the mail2note service on a set interval for new messages
Create Markdown notes with attachments in a target folder
Configure filename templates using date, subject, and message ID
Trigger an immediate sync from the ribbon or command palette
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README includes a privacy section stating no telemetry and that the API key and note contents are never logged or shared.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to get email content into the vault automatically; this bridges an email inbox to vault notes.

relations.evidence: Forward emails to your personal mail2note address and have them appear automatically in your vault

summary: Email-to-vault sync that polls a mail2note inbox and saves incoming emails as Markdown notes with attachments.
